items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 155:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Mochin of ZA come out only upon the MAN of the Mazal, which are the aspect of the MAN of the first restriction; and these MAN are indeed male MAN, namely the Yesod of the Malchut of the first restriction, which suffice only for the great ZON, which are above the aspect of Malchut. But the Nukva Rachel needs the aspect of female MAN, namely from the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction; therefore she cannot receive the Mochin from the NHY of Ima, namely from the NHY of YESHSUT, as above in Answer 285, in the second way — because she has no share in the MAN of Ima, which come from the MAN of the Mazal, being male Gevurot from the Yesod of Malchut. Therefore she has no Mochin of face to face with which to couple with ZA, except through the illumination of the crown of Gevura (Atara de-Gevura) of ZA in the Malchut of Ima, as is known. Hence, throughout the six thousand years she needs to receive the Mochin from ZA, in the clothing of his NHY, and not in the clothing of the NHY of YESHSUT. However, at the end of correction, the Malchut of the first restriction will be revealed in RADLA, in the secret of “head of the corner” (Rosh Pina), and then Rachel will have the aspect of female MAN of the first restriction, and will be able to be included in Ima and receive the Mochin from her by herself. Then the NHY of YESHSUT will clothe in the Nukva, like the NHY of AVI in ZA, and they will both use one crown. See Answer 7. (Item 189. And Or Pnimi, Sub Header “However”).
